metadata.name: Dream — Dynamic Orchestration
metadata.description: Demo workflow for the per-step / team / llm_decision dream: an LLM orchestrator decides which step runs next. Bind a team (Phase 2) or set per-step overrides (Phase 1) so each step runs on its own model; the verify step's resolved model is the one asked to route.

steps.prompt: Implement the requested change. When you are done, call step_done().

steps.name: Verify & Route
steps.prompt: Run the tests and lint. Report the outcome via step_done().

config.prompt: Given the verification outcome, what should we do next?
